October 2026

How to Access Board and Committee Meeting Videos →
Sunday, October 4, 2026
Log in to the Palm Hill website, open “Committees of Palm Hill,” then choose Board Meeting Videos or Committee Meeting Videos. Contact the webmaster if you need a site account.
